newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sees CVRD sale going ahead.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sees CVRD sale going ahead.

text.p: The privatization of Brazilian mining conglomerate Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), due to start April 29, will not be delayed by a dispute involving the company's Urucum Mineracao SA project, said Planning Minister Antonio Kandir.
"There is no reason for the privatzation of CVRD to be delayed. It is confirmed for April 29," Kandir told reporters.

The National Privatization Council (CND) authorized Thursday the National Development Bank (BNDES) to negotiate within 90 days a possible repurchase by governments of Mato Grosso and Mato Grosso do Sul states of a stake in Urucum.

CVRD bought 46 percent of Urucum, an iron ore and manganese mining project in Mato Grosso do Sul, from Mato Grosso state for 17 million reais before the state was split into two. The states claim irregularities in the sale, principally that the price was too low.
The CVRD privatization process is due to kick off on April 29 with the sale of a 45 percent controlling stake of the company's voting shares.
